meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 Signal 消息渠道，实现原生收发。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里直接收发 Signal 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Signal channel for native messaging.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send and receive Signal messages in your app.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 通过 signal-cli 作为你现有手机号的“辅助设备”接入 Signal,不新开号码;Signal 私聊、群聊消息会交给 Claude,并以该号码发出回复,默认每个群聊独立会话。
howto.when: 在 /setup 流程中选择接入 Signal,或当你说出“添加 Signal 频道”“接入 Signal”等要求时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Signal 频道接好,按我的手机号关联。
say.note: 会运行 signal-cli 设备关联步骤并提示扫码。

say.text: 往 Signal 的 Note to Self 发条测试消息,收到请回复。
以后我的日程提醒都发到 Signal 私聊。
say.note: 提醒会经 Signal 发出;新用户需先完成授权。

howto.what_en: After applying, Claude joins Signal as a secondary device on your existing phone number — no new number. Chat and group messages are delivered to Claude, and replies go out from that number. Groups get separate sessions by default.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you choose Signal during a /setup flow, or ask Claude to add/connect a Signal channel.

say_en.text: Set up my Signal channel linked to my phone number.
say_en.note: Runs signal-cli device-link and shows the QR code.

say_en.text: Send a Note to Self test message and reply when you see it.
say_en.note: The reply arrives in your own Signal account.

say_en.text: Send my future reminders to my Signal DMs.
say_en.note: Requires channel wiring and user access to be granted.
